Hi Alicia —

Appreciate the clarity on constraints. I've drafted a one-page MAP and an attached evaluation checklist that maps decision points to measurable gating criteria (security, latency, cost) and recommended timelines. Quick summary below:

- Week 0–1: Kickoff + access to test dataset (ClearHealth)
- Week 2: Security review + SOC2 evidence exchange (we'll provide SOC2 summary)
- Week 3–4: Proof-of-concept runs (Hosted staging) to validate latency and functional outputs with prefix caching enabled
- Week 5: Scale test on Dedicated (if latency economics or throughput requirements need isolation) — 48 hour soak at peak QPS
- Week 6: Final decision & procurement sign-off — options: Hosted (fastest), Dedicated (predictable throughput + isolation), Private (on-prem/VPC) if regulator requires no cloud processing

Decision criteria (short):
- If ClearHealth accepts Redwood hosted with VPC egress controls and provided SOC2 evidence, choose Hosted (fastest path to production).
- If strict isolation or contractual SLAs needed, choose Dedicated (reserved capacity).
- If data residency/airgap required, choose Private.

I've attached: ClearHealth_MAP_v1.xlsx (MAP with milestones), evaluation-checklist.md, SOC2-summary.pdf.

Next step: can we lock a 30-minute exec alignment on Thursday or Friday next week to agree the deployment runway?

Thanks,

Looping in a couple of technical notes for the MAP:

- For the 500 QPS peak, Dedicated will be required if ClearHealth expects <100ms p95 for >10-token generations without aggressive batching. Hosted can meet moderate latencies but depends on shared capacity and routing policies.
- Recommend enabling prefix/KV caching during PoC to lower token cost and improve tail latency for repeated prompts (medical triage templates).
- If ClearHealth can accept US-only region routing and uses our KMS integration, we can shorten the security gating to a 3-day window (we can provide key-handshake docs).

If we plan a 48-hour soak on Dedicated, ops needs exact test schedule and an approximate traffic profile (rps per endpoint).
